name: Cosmetics Products Management System
tagline: PHP and MySQL-based online store for cosmetics and beauty products with inventory, order management, and PayPal payments.
description: Cosmetics and Beauty Product Online Store is a web-based shopping and management system for a cosmetics business. Customers can browse products, filter by category or brand, search products, manage a shopping cart, place orders, and view or cancel pending orders. Administrators manage brands, categories, products, inventory, orders, users, system information, and date-wise sales reports. The README states that online payments use the PayPal API.
problemStatement: A cosmetics business needs a web-based system for customers to browse and order products while staff manage products, inventory, orders, users, and sales information.
solution: A PHP/OOP and MySQL web application with separate customer-facing and admin interfaces, product discovery and ordering tools, inventory controls, order management, and PayPal API payment support.

admin: Brand management: add, list, view, update, and delete brands
Category management: add, list, view, update, and delete categories
Product management: add, list, update, and delete products
Inventory management: add, list, update, and delete stock by product variant
Order management: list orders, view details, update status, mark as paid, and delete orders
User list management with CRUD operations
client: List orders and view order details

setupSteps: Install and start Apache and MySQL using XAMPP or WAMP
Enable or uncomment the GD Library in php.ini
Place the project folder in XAMPP htdocs or WAMP www
Open the client-side or admin-side local URL
